blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Text from multiple sources can become interleaved into a single sequence when attribution metadata is lost, such as overlapping speech transcripts, complex document reading flows, or concurrent agent streams.
While all observed words remain present, their underlying source ownership is unknown.
We formalize this challenge as Word-Level Text Unmixing : given an interleaved lexical stream and the source count K K , recover the original source sequences while preserving every word occurrence and its within-source order exactly.
Conventional large language model (LLM) paradigms approach this by generating separated source texts directly.
However, coupling latent ownership inference with lexical regeneration frequently causes LLMs to omit, duplicate, or hallucinate words, violating the exact-reconstruction objective.
To resolve this, we propose Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing ( EPoR ) , a framework that clearly separates ownership prediction from sequence reconstruction.
During training, EPoR adapts a causal LLM to predict canonical ownership routes conditioned on the interleaved stream and prior routing decisions, inducing dynamic, history-conditioned source contexts without lexical regeneration.
At inference, EPoR pairs completion-safe constrained decoding with deterministic indexed reconstruction, guaranteeing structurally valid K K -source partitions that preserve every observed token occurrence exactly once.
For systematic evaluation, we introduce UnMixBench , spanning controlled synthetic mixtures, timestamp-derived speech from AMI and ICSI, layout-derived document streams from ReadingBank, and simulated concurrent digital outputs.
Across five evaluation tracks, a 4B EPoR model achieves the lowest minimum-permutation word error rate (MP-WER) among finetuned baselines, reducing the five-track mean by 22.3% relative to compact source-array generation and competing favorably with zero-shot frontier LLMs.
These findings indicate that when lexical evidence is fully observed, decoupling ownership routing from sequence reconstruction can provide a more reliable and structurally sound alternative to generative decoders.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text from multiple sources frequently becomes interleaved into a single sequence when attribution metadata is lost during downstream processing.
Although the observed words remain intact, the mapping between each word occurrence and its original source is unknown.
Recovering these latent source assignments is critical for restoring readable transcripts, coherent document structures, and interpretable digital records across several primary settings.
In temporal interleaving for speech processing, transcribed words from multiple speakers merge into a single chronological stream due to overlaps or interruptions, making source attribution essential for speaker-aware analysis ( Paturi et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
In spatial interleaving , document extraction systems often serialize two-dimensional layouts like multi-column pages into an incorrect linear order ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) .
Furthermore, concurrent interleaving occurs in digital systems when collaborative agents or unlabelled event logs emit partial outputs into a shared stream where only the arrival order is preserved ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
All these scenarios share a fundamental structure where the observed words are available but their source ownership is unknown.
We formalize this problem as Word-Level Text Unmixing , as shown in Figure 1 .
Given a completely interleaved word stream and source count K K , the objective is to recover the distinct source sequences such that every observed word occurrence is used exactly once and its original within-source order is preserved.
Unlike coarser text separation tasks like utterance-level conversation disentanglement ( Elsner and Charniak, 2008 ; Kummerfeld et al., 2019 ) , paragraph-level style-change detection ( Zangerle et al., 2022 ) , or temporally grounded speaker diarization ( Paturi et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , word-level text unmixing requires resolving ownership shifts between adjacent words using solely the mixed lexical stream.
blocks.zh:
所有这些情景都具有一个基本结构,即观测到的词可以使用,但其来源所有权不明。
如图1所示,我们将此问题正式化为文字级文本解相。
鉴于一个完全互通的字流和源数K K ,其目标是恢复不同的源序列,使每个被观测到的字出都精确使用一次并保留其原始的源内顺序.
与较粗的文本分离任务,如说词层对话分解(Elsner and Charniak, 2008;Kummerfeld等, 2019),段落层风格变化检测(Zangerle等, 2022),或时间上基于扬声器的对等化(Paturi等, 2023;Wang等, 2024)不同,词层文本分解需要仅用混合词流解决相邻词之间的所有权转移.

blocks.en:
While generative large language models (LLMs) are commonly used for text-to-structure extraction ( Lu et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Sainz et al., 2024 ) , directly prompting them to generate separated source arrays presents two fundamental limitations for word-level text unmixing.
First, because each ownership assignment alters the partial source contexts needed to interpret subsequent words, models must perform history-conditioned routing decoupled from lexical reconstruction.
Second, standard free-generation paradigms couple ownership inference with text generation.
This allows structurally correct ownership deductions to be corrupted by the omission, duplication, or alteration of observed words, directly violating the exact-reconstruction objective.
blocks.zh:
虽然基因大语言模型(LLMs)通常用于文本到结构取出(Lu等,2022;Wang等,2023;Sainz等,2024),但直接促使它们生成分离出源数组,对词层文本的解相提出了两个基本限制.
首先,由于每次所有权转让都会改变解释后续词组所需的部分源背景,模型必须执行历史条件的路由,与词汇重建脱钩。
其次,标准的自由生成范式将所有权推论与文本生成相配.
这使得结构上正确的所有权扣减被被被被观察到的单词的省略,重复,或被修改所腐蚀,直接违反了精确重建的目标.

blocks.en:
To resolve this, we introduce Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing ( EPoR ) , a framework that decouples learned source ownership from deterministic reconstruction.
During training, a causal language model predicts a single ownership label per observed word, conditioned on the interleaved stream and prior routing decisions.
This enables history-conditioned ownership prediction rather than prone-to-error lexical regeneration.
At inference, EPoR a completion-safe constrained beam search to evaluate candidate routes, ensuring the selected paths can form complete K K -source partitions.
Indexed reconstruction then mechanically gathers the original word occurrences based on these routes, enforcing structural validity and exact evidence preservation.

为了解决这个问题,我们引入了证据-保留所有权路线(EPOR),这个框架将学到的来源所有权与决定性重建脱钩。
在训练期间,一个因果语言模型预测每个被观测到的单词的单一所有权标签,以相隔流和之前的路由决定为条件.
这有利于以历史为条件的所有权预测,而不是易被错误地再生。
推论,EPoR是用于评价候选路线的可完成性-安全受限束搜索,确保所选路径可以形成完整的K-源分区.
索引重建后机械地根据这些路径来收集出原始的单词发生,强制结构有效性和准确的证据保存.

blocks.en:
For systematic evaluation, we construct UnMixBench , a benchmark covering controlled synthetic mixtures, timestamp-derived speech from AMI and ICSI, layout-derived reading flows from ReadingBank, and simulated concurrent digital streams via WikiText.
Across the five principal evaluation tracks, a 4B EPoR model achieves the lowest mean minimum-permutation word error rate ( MP-WER ) among task-finetuned free-generation and structured baselines, yielding a 22.3% error reduction relative to compact source-array generation.
Furthermore, EPoR remains highly competitive with zero-shot frontier language models.

在五个主要评价轨道上,一个4B EPoR模型在任务过滤的自由生成和结构化基线中实现了最小平均输出值误差率(MP-WER),相对于紧凑源阵列生成,实现了22.3%的误差减少.
此外,EPOR仍然与零镜头前沿语言模型竞争激烈.

blocks.en: Our key contributions include the following. • We formalize word-level text unmixing , a fine-grained de-interleaving problem aimed at recovering the ownership of each word occurrence from mixed text. • We propose Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing ( EPoR ), a structured framework that decouples history-conditioned source ownership prediction from evidence-preserving reconstruction. • We introduce UnMixBench to evaluate text unmixing across temporal, spatial, and concurrent serialization scenarios, demonstrating EPoR ’s superior performance across multiple domains.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
In conversation disentanglement, most methods use lexical context,
speaker and temporal metadata, mentions, reply structure, and learned
representations ( Elsner and Charniak, 2010 ; Mehri and Carenini, 2017 ; Jiang et al., 2018 ; Kummerfeld et al., 2019 ; Yu and Joty, 2020 ) .
Extensions consider zero-shot or weakly supervised objectives and explicit
speaker or reference structure ( Chi and Rudnicky, 2021 ; Zhu et al., 2021 ; Huang et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2022 ) .
These settings retain intact linguistic units and often expose source-related
metadata ( Chang et al., 2023 ; Gouravajhala et al., 2023 ) .
Style-change detection similarly locates authorship changes at paragraph or
sentence boundaries using stylistic evidence ( Zangerle et al., 2022 ) .
Text unmixing instead reconstructs sources from individually interleaved word occurrences.

Speaker separation and diarization use waveforms, timing, spatial cues, and
learned speaker representations; multimodal systems also use lexical context ( Chen et al., 2017 ; Horiguchi et al., 2020 ; Park and Georgiou, 2018 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .
Lexical variants and language-model post-processing show that words can inform
fine-grained speaker assignment or correct upstream diarization labels ( Park and Georgiou, 2018 ; Paturi et al., 2023 ; Park et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
These systems typically receive acoustic evidence or the initial speaker hypothesis. Instead, our task recovers the latent sources without acoustic cues or the upstream speaker hypothesis and requires exact preservation of the observed word occurrences.
Related formulations also arise beyond NLP, including shuffle recognition and string unshuffling, document reading-order recovery, and blind source separation. We discuss these broader connections and their distinctions from word-level text unmixing in Appendix E .

Consider two latent source sequences, “the volcano erupts” and “the chef cooks.”

For this scenario, the latent ownership route is z = ( 1 , 2 , 1 , 1 , 2 , 2 ) , z=(1,2,1,1,2,2), which groups ( x 1 , x 3 , x 4 ) (x_{1},x_{3},x_{4}) into “the volcano erupts” and ( x 2 , x 5 , x 6 ) (x_{2},x_{5},x_{6}) into “the chef cooks.”
An ownership route is a sequence of source labels for the observed occurrences.
The model does not observe z z but rather predicts this auxiliary representation in order to reconstruct the sources.

blocks.en: 4 Approach: Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing
blocks.zh: 4 方法:证据-保留所有权

blocks.en:
EPoR separates learned source ownership from evidence preservation. During training, a causal LLM predicts an ownership label for each observed word, conditioned on the complete mixed stream, the source count, and preceding labels. These labels define partial source contexts that guide subsequent predictions.
At inference, the model scores candidate ownership routes, while completion-safe beam search retains prefixes that can form a partition into K K non-empty sources. Indexed reconstruction then selects the original occurrences in source-local order. Figure 2 shows both stages.

推论,模型对候选所有权路线进行分数,而完成-安全光束搜索则保留了可以形成分出K非空源的前缀. 索引重建后按源本地顺序选择原始出错 。 图2显示了这两个阶段的情况。

blocks.en: 6.5 What Makes Text Unmixing Difficult?
blocks.zh: 6.5 是什么使文本无法混合?

blocks.en: Our controlled analyses point to two distinct sources of difficulty: ambiguity in the ownership route and similarity between the latent sources. Route ambiguity is not monotonic in mixing intensity, as shown in Figure 3 . With two sources, maximal switching forces an alternating route and can therefore make the ownership structure easier to recover, whereas intermediate mixing permits a less constrained set of assignments. Recovery is also worse for source groups with higher frozen-encoder similarity after exact matching on K K , T T , and target M M , consistent with reduced lexical distinctiveness between sources. Appendix D.8 provides the corresponding controlled analyses.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 结论和限制

blocks.en:
We introduce word-level text unmixing, a fine-grained de-interleaving problem in which complete lexical evidence is observed but source ownership is unknown. EPoR approaches this by separating history-conditioned ownership prediction from deterministic sequence reconstruction: it predicts canonical ownership routes under completion-safe constraints and then reconstructs each source directly from the indexed input occurrences. Across the five principal UnMixBench tracks, EPoR achieves the lowest mean MP-WER among task-adapted free-generation and structured baselines while preserving every observed word occurrence exactly, and remains competitive with zero-shot frontier LLMs.
These results suggest that, when lexical evidence is fully observed, decoupling ownership inference from lexical regeneration provides a reliable alternative to direct source-text regeneration.

我们引入了单词级的文本不相混合,这是一个精细的去串联问题,其中观察到完整的词典证据,但来源所有权不明. EPoR通过将历史条件化的所有权预测与确定序列重建区分开来进行处理:它预测在完成安全条件下的犬类所有权路径,然后直接从索引输入点重建出每个源. 在五个主要的UnMix Bench轨道上,EPOR在经过任务调整的自由生成和结构化基线中实现了最低的MP-WER,同时精确地保留了所观察到的每个单词的发生,并且仍然与零镜头边框LLMs具有竞争力.
这些结果表明,在充分观察了法理证据后,将所有权推断与法理再生脱钩,为直接源文字再生提供了可靠的替代办法.

blocks.en:
There are several limitations remaining in this work.
First, the current formulation assumes that the source count K K is known. Jointly inferring the number of sources and their ownership is an important extension. Second, finite-beam decoding guarantees structural validity but not correct ownership, and our candidate-ranking analysis indicates that substantial ranking error remains even among legal routes. Improving route scoring or reranking may therefore yield further gains.
Third, our formulation isolates ownership recovery under complete lexical observations. Real pipelines may additionally contain ASR/OCR insertions, deletions, or substitutions, so extending evidence-preserving routing to noisy or incomplete observations remains an open problem.

第三,我们的提法将所有权的恢复孤立在完整的逻辑观察之下。 真正的管道可能还包含ASR/OCR的插入,删除,或替换等内容,因此将保留证据的路由延伸到吵闹或不完整的观测上,仍然是一个公开的问题.

would reduce evidence preservation if its position could not be assigned to an
emitted source bucket.

blocks.en: Appendix E Extended Related Work

blocks.en:
Word-level text unmixing is also related to several established problem families outside the closest NLP settings reviewed in Section 2 . These connections concern different aspects of the problem: formal-language work studies order-preserving interleavings of discrete sequences, document understanding studies recovery of reading structure from spatial and visual evidence, and blind source separation studies recovery of latent sources from observed mixtures.
They help situate text unmixing among broader source-recovery and de-interleaving problems.

它们有助于将文本与更广泛的来源恢复和脱钩问题混为一谈。

blocks.en: E.1 Shuffle Languages and String Unshuffling
blocks.zh: E.1 摇摆语言和摇摆

blocks.en: Order-preserving sequence interleaving has a classical formulation in formal-language theory through the shuffle product . For strings u u and v v , their shuffle contains the strings obtainable by interleaving symbols from u u and v v while preserving the internal order of each string. Early work studied the corresponding merge recognition problem: given an observed string and candidate component strings, determine whether the former is an order-preserving merge of the latter ( Mansfield, 1982 ) . For any fixed number of given component strings, merge recognition admits a polynomial-time algorithm, whereas allowing the number of components to vary as part of the input makes the problem NP-complete ( Mansfield, 1983 ) . The shuffle product has subsequently been studied more broadly as an operation in formal-language theory and combinatorics on words, including its expressive properties and connections to models of concurrent processes ( Berstel et al., 2010 ; Restivo, 2015 ) .

blocks.en: These problems share with word-level text unmixing the combinatorial structure of order-preserving interleaving, but differ in what is observed and what must be inferred. Classical merge recognition is supplied with the candidate component strings, while shuffle-square recognition replaces this information with the strong constraint that the two latent components are identical. In word-level text unmixing, by contrast, all K K source sequences are latent, need not be identical, and have exchangeable source identities. The observation preserves the individual word occurrences but not their source ownership, so recovery requires inferring an occurrence-level partition from the lexical stream. The classical complexity results above therefore do not directly establish the computational complexity of word-level text unmixing; rather, shuffle theory provides a formal analogue of its underlying order-preserving interleaving structure.
blocks.zh: 这些问题与文字层面的文本解相混合,将顺序保留互换的组合结构相统一,但在观察的内容和必须推断的内容上有所不同. 经典合并识别由候选组件字符串提供,而shuffle-square识别则以两个潜在组件完全相同的强烈制约来取代这一信息. 相形之下,在字位解混的文本中,所有K K源序列都是潜伏的,不需要完全相同,并且具有可交换的源身份. 观察保留了单个单词的发生,但不保留其源属,因此恢复需要推断出从词条流中发生级分出. 因此,上面的经典复杂性结果并不能直接确定词层文本不混合的计算复杂性;相反地,shuffle理论提供了其基础的顺序保留互换结构的正式模拟.

blocks.en: E.2 Reading-Order Recovery in Document Understanding
blocks.zh: E.2 文件理解中的读取顺序

blocks.en: Document analysis provides another closely related setting in which serialization can obscure latent textual structure. Reading-order detection has long been treated as part of recovering the logical organization of complex documents. Earlier work developed representations and evaluation procedures for reading order over document regions, including layouts with ordered, unordered, and grouped relations ( Clausner et al., 2013 ) . More recent document-understanding systems learn reading structure using textual features together with explicit spatial or visual information. LayoutReader predicts reading order from text and layout representations ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , while ERNIE-Layout incorporates reading-order prediction into multimodal pretraining over textual, spatial, and visual features ( Peng et al., 2022 ) . Other approaches directly address incorrect document serialization through token-path prediction ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) or model reading order as ordering relations among layout elements rather than as a single global permutation ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 文件分析提供了另一个密切相关的设置,其中序列化可以模糊潜在的文本结构. 阅读-订单检测长期以来一直被视为恢复复杂文件逻辑组织的一部分. 早先的工作为文件区域的阅读秩序制定了陈述和评价程序,包括有秩序、无秩序和分组关系(Clausner等,2013年)。 更近的文档理解系统利用文字特征以及明确的空间或视觉信息来学习读取结构. 版面阅读器从文字和布局表示(Wang等,2021年)预测读取顺序,而ERNIE-Layout则将读取顺序预测纳入多模式预训中,相对于文字,空间,和视觉特征(Peng等,2022年). 其他方法通过符号路径预测(张等,2023年)或模型读取顺序直接解决了文件序列不正确的问题,作为排版元素之间的顺序关系,而不是作为单一的全球通相(张等,2024年).

blocks.en: The spatial track of UNMIXBENCH is motivated by the same broad failure mode: multiple coherent reading flows can be serialized into a single stream in an order that does not preserve those flows. The information interface is different, however. For the ReadingBank track, document metadata are used during benchmark construction to derive deterministic operational reading flows and the corresponding ownership routes, whereas the evaluated model receives only the resulting lexical stream x x and source count K K . Layout coordinates, page geometry, visual features, and the reading-order metadata used for construction are not supplied to the model.
blocks.zh: UNMIXBENCH的空间轨迹的动机是相同的广义故障模式:多条连贯的读取流量可以被序列化成一串流,顺序不能保持这些流量. 然而,信息接口不同。 对于 ReadingBank 轨道,在基准构建过程中使用文档元数据来得出决定性的操作读取流量和相应的所有者路径,而被评价的模型只接收由此得到的Lexical stream x和源数K K. 布局坐标,页面几何,可视特征,以及用于构建的读取顺序元数据不提供给模型.

blocks.en: The spatial text-unmixing track should therefore not be interpreted as an alternative to layout-aware reading-order prediction. Reading-order systems aim to exploit surviving document geometry and multimodal structure to determine how page elements should be traversed. Text unmixing instead studies a downstream recovery setting in which such attribution information has already been discarded while the lexical occurrences themselves remain available. It asks whether the latent reading flows can still be recovered from the serialized lexical evidence alone.
blocks.zh: 因此,空间文本-不混合轨道不应被解释为是布局-意识读取-顺序预测的替代. 阅读顺序系统旨在利用幸存的文档几何和多模式结构来确定页元件应如何穿行。 相反,文本解密研究了一种下游回收环境,在这种环境中,这种归属信息已经被丢弃,而词汇本身却仍然可用。 它询问,仅从序列法证据中是否可以找到潜在的读取流量。

blocks.en: E.3 Conceptual Relation to Blind Source Separation
blocks.zh: E.3 与盲源分离的概念关系

blocks.en: A broader conceptual connection arises with blind source separation (BSS), which studies recovery of latent source signals from observed mixtures without direct access to the individual sources. Early adaptive methods sought to separate unknown independent sources from sensor observations ( Jutten and Hérault, 1991 ) . Independent component analysis subsequently provided a statistical formulation based on recovering components with reduced statistical dependence ( Comon, 1994 ) , while information-theoretic approaches demonstrated blind separation by maximizing information transfer ( Bell and Sejnowski, 1995 ) . Classical surveys and algorithmic treatments further developed the statistical principles and practical methods underlying BSS and independent component analysis ( Cardoso, 1998 ; Hyvärinen and Oja, 2000 ) .
blocks.zh: 与盲源分离(BSS)产生更广泛的概念联系,后者研究从所观察到的混合物中回收潜在源信号而不直接接触单个源。 早期适应方法试图将未知的独立来源与传感器观测区分开来(Jutten和Hérault,1991年)。 独立组成部分分析随后提供了一种基于统计依赖程度降低的恢复组成部分的统计公式(Comon,1994年),而信息理论方法则通过最大限度的信息转移表明盲目分离(Bell和Sejnowski,1995年)。 经典调查和算法处理进一步发展了BSS和独立组成部分分析所依据的统计原则和实用方法(Cardoso,1998;Hyvärinen和Oja,2000)。

blocks.en: The relation to word-level text unmixing is conceptual rather than algebraic. Classical BSS generally observes superpositions or transformations of simultaneously active source signals and recovers the underlying signals under assumptions about the sources and mixing process, often including statistical independence. Word-level text unmixing does not assume an additive mixture, a linear mixing matrix, or an ICA-style independence model. Instead, the mixing mechanism is serialization: discrete word occurrences from several sources are interleaved into a shared sequence while each occurrence itself remains intact. What is lost is the correspondence between an occurrence and its latent source.
blocks.zh: 与词层文本不相混合的关系是概念性而非代数. 古典BSS一般观察同时活性源信号的叠位或变相,并依据对源和混合过程的假设来恢复基础信号,通常包括统计独立性. Word-level text unmixing 不假设添加剂混合物,线性混合矩阵,或ICA风格的独立模型. 相反地,混合机制是序列化的:来自多个来源的离散的单词发生被放入一个共享的序列中,而每个发生本身仍然完好无损. 所损失的是事件与其潜在来源之间的对应关系。

blocks.en: Thus, text unmixing is better viewed as a discrete source-attribution problem under order-preserving interleaving than as an instance of classical BSS. The broader connection is that both settings separate evidence produced by latent sources after source identity has become entangled in the observation process. In the text-unmixing setting studied here, this abstraction is specialized to complete lexical evidence with missing ownership.
blocks.zh: 因此,文本不相混合比起典型的BSS例子,在保留顺序的互换下,更好被视为一个离散源分配问题. 更广泛的联系是,这两种设置都由潜在来源在来源身份被缠入观测过程后产生的单独证据。 在此处所研究的文本解相设置中,这种抽象是专门用来完成缺少所有权的词典证据.
